summary: Iteration 16 — Admin Dashboard hub, ads, tri-lang categories, and marketing site multilingual switch. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases passed covering all NEW endpoints listed in the review request (categories tri-lang + painting=brush, admin categories CRUD + reorder + in-use guard, admin stats KPI, admin users search/deactivate/reactivate/force-verify/delete + self-guard, admin bookings monitor, admin revenue, admin broadcast wilaya validation, CSV exports for users/providers/bookings with content-disposition, public ads listing with impression/click counters no-auth, admin ads CRUD, auth guards returning 401 for unauth and 403 for non-admin). critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin_dashboard.py: admin_bookings _hydrate uses .to_list(2) — safe because it filters by exactly 2 ids (client + provider), but the hard-coded 2 is fragile if the query ever changes. Consider .to_list(length=len(pids)).

routes/ads.py AdPatch: model_dump(exclude_unset=True) is applied so partial patches work; however 'link_url'/'subtitle' can be legitimately cleared to null — currently patching them to null works because the value is included in exclude_unset only when explicitly sent. OK, but worth documenting.
routes/admin_dashboard.py test_wilaya_backfill_idempotent (pre-existing iter15) may now leave DB in an over-updated state across runs — not a bug in this iteration, just noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (marketing site multilingual: EN/FR/AR + RTL + logo untranslated + persistence verified)
